how_to_add: Open the Lunar Client Launcher and click the Versions / Profiles button on the left sidebar.
Select Minecraft 26.3 and ensure the Fabric add-on is selected (Lunar bundles Fabric Loader 0.20.1, Fabric API, Sodium, Iris, Replay Mod, FerriteCore, and Noxesium automatically).
Click the Settings Gear (⚙) button at the bottom-right of the 26.3 version card.
Select the Mods tab at the top of the profile settings window.

Drag and drop your downloaded Fabric .jar files (including required library jars like malilib-fabric-26.3-0.30.2.jar and cicada-lib-0.15.3+26.3.jar) into the window, or click the folder (📁) icon at the top to open the profile's mods folder directly.

Keep the Enabled checkbox ticked next to each mod (or use the launcher's Explore / Modpacks tabs to install directly from Modrinth); if a custom Fabric mod conflicts with Lunar hooks, click the Vanilla icon at the bottom-right of the version card to launch vanilla Fabric inside Lunar.
notes: Already in Lunar, so not listed here: Minimap and Waypoints, WAILA (block info), Saturation HUD, Sodium and Iris. Turn them on under Right Shift → Mods.
Minecraft Java Edition 26.3 ('Wilderness Bound', released 2026-09-15) is the current stable release under Mojang's calendar-year numbering system (26 = 2026, .3 = third Java drop of the year).

Lunar Client does not restrict you to an allowlist on modern versions: any third-party Fabric .jar can be added on Minecraft 1.16.5 and newer (including 26.3). Legacy versions (1.7.10-1.12.2) do not support custom Fabric mod loading.

All four of Masa's technical mods (Litematica, MiniHUD, Tweakeroo, Item Scroller) have official 26.3 Fabric builds on Modrinth (maintained with sakura-ryoko) and require MaLiLib (malilib-fabric-26.3-0.30.2.jar).
Litematica schematic ghost rendering breaks when Iris shaders are active on 1.21.3+ and 26.3; press K to toggle shaders off while placing schematics.
Do a Barrel Roll 3.8.5+26.3 requires CICADA (cicada-lib-0.15.3+26.3.jar) in the mods folder.

MiniHUD's Structure Bounding Boxes (witch huts, nether fortresses, pillager outposts) work out-of-the-box in singleplayer; on a multiplayer server, the server must run Servux (servux-fabric-26.3-0.12.2.jar) and you must enter /minihud-seed <seed> for slime chunks.

Tweakeroo's Easy Place / Accurate Block Placement / Free Camera features and Do a Barrel Roll flight physics can trigger anti-cheat on public servers unless the server allows them or runs Carpet / Servux.

mods.name: Do a Barrel Roll
mods.what: Adds pitch, yaw, and roll flight physics (6-DOF banking and barrel rolls) when flying with an elytra between farms.
features: 360-degree pitch, yaw, and roll camera/elytra banking
Mouse and keyboard roll/thrust controls
Momentum-based flight camera smoothing
Client-side thrust/roll toggles via Mod Menu
mods.lunar_note: Add do_a_barrel_roll-fabric-3.8.5+26.3.jar and its required dependency cicada-lib-0.15.3+26.3.jar to Lunar's Mods tab.

hotkeys.does: Thrust, once thrust is switched on in the config (no default key for that)

mods.name: Litematica
mods.what: Loads .litematic/.schematic files as a 3D hologram with layer-by-layer rendering, wrong-block verifier, material list, and Easy Place.
features: 3D schematic hologram overlay with single-layer / layer-range slicing
Material List HUD and CSV export (counts missing vs available chests/inventory items)
Schematic Verifier (highlights wrong blocks, wrong block states/orientations, and missing blocks)
Easy Place Mode (click and hold to place correct block states directly onto the schematic ghost)
Pick-block from schematic ghost (automatically swaps matching block from inventory to hand)
mods.lunar_note: Add litematica-fabric-26.3-0.29.1.jar and malilib-fabric-26.3-0.30.2.jar in Lunar's Mods tab; disable Iris shaders (press K) while viewing schematics on 26.3.

hotkeys.does: Material list of the loaded schematic
Schematic verifier (finds wrong and missing blocks)
With the stick: change tool mode
With the stick: set corner 1 / corner 2
Pick the schematic block you look at
Save the selection as a schematic

mods.name: MiniHUD
mods.what: Renders technical world overlays (light levels, slime chunks, structure bounding boxes, random tick range, beacon range) and 24/32/128-block mob spawn/despawn spheres.
features: Light Level overlay with configurable numbers and spawnable-spot markers
Slime Chunks overlay with mouse-wheel adjustable top Y-level
Shape Renderer with Despawn Sphere ( > 128), Can Despawn Sphere ( > 32), Can Spawn Sphere ( > 24), and Adjustable Spawn Sphere
Random Ticked Chunks (player-following) overlay and Random Ticked Chunks (fixed) overlay
Beacon Range overlay for levels 1-4 plus Conduit Range overlay and Lightning Rod Range overlay
Structure Bounding Boxes main for witch huts, nether fortresses, and pillager outposts
Spawnable column heights overlay, Biome Border overlay, and Spawn Chunks (real) overlay
Villager Info Overlay showing zombie conversion timers and enchanted book trades, plus customizable mini-F3 HUD lines (toggle with H, config menu H + C)
mods.lunar_note: Add minihud-fabric-26.3-0.41.2.jar and malilib-fabric-26.3-0.30.2.jar in Lunar's Mods tab; press H + C in-game to configure overlays and shapes.

hotkeys.does: Settings: light levels, slime chunks, spawn spheres and the other overlays are switched on here (no default keys)
Look at a chest or shulker: preview its inventory

mods.name: Tweakeroo
mods.what: Client-side technical building tweaks including Free Camera (spectator-like camera for inspecting farm redstone), Accurate/Flexible Block Placement, Hand Restock, and Periodic Hold/Click for AFK farms.
features: Free Camera to fly the camera through redstone wiring and mob chutes without moving the player
Flexible Block Placement (rotation/offset placement) and Accurate Block Placement (place observers/pistons facing any direction)
Hand Restock (automatically refills the held stack from inventory before it runs out during farm building)
Fast Block Placement (places blocks cleanly across a plane or line without misclicks)
Periodic Attack / Periodic Use (built-in client auto-clicker for raid, gold, enderman, and cobble farms; config menu X + C)
mods.lunar_note: Add tweakeroo-fabric-26.3-0.30.1.jar and malilib-fabric-26.3-0.30.2.jar to Lunar's Mods tab.

hotkeys.does: Settings: every tweak (Easy Place, free camera, …) gets its key here; none have one by default
Placement restriction: plane, face, column, line, diagonal, layer
While placing: flexible placement, rotation; or inventory preview

mods.name: Item Scroller
mods.what: Moves item stacks across chests/shulkers with the scroll wheel or drag-clicking, mass-crafts items from a 18-slot recipe memory, and one-click trades with villagers.
features: Scroll wheel and modifier-drag transfers (single items, full stacks, all matching items, or entire inventory)
Mass crafting table memory (18 saved recipes; scroll or hold key to craft and drop stacks of pistons, hoppers, or gold blocks)
One-click villager trade favorites and fast restock trading
Drop all matching items from open storage containers with a modifier click (config menu I + C)
mods.lunar_note: Add itemscroller-fabric-26.3-0.33.1.jar and malilib-fabric-26.3-0.30.2.jar to Lunar's Mods tab.

hotkeys.does: Move one item from each stack
Move everything to the other inventory
Move items up / down between inventories
Drop one item from each stack
Drop every stack like the one under the cursor
Sort the inventory under the cursor
On a crafting result: store the recipe
Craft everything with the selected recipe
Mass craft and throw the results

mods.name: MaLiLib
mods.what: Required shared configuration, keybind, and rendering library for Litematica, MiniHUD, Tweakeroo, and Item Scroller.
features: Multi-key chord hotkey engine (press/release/both, in-game vs GUI context)
Unified in-game configuration screens for all Masa mods
Shared overlay and HUD rendering utilities
mods.lunar_note: Required in Lunar's Mods tab whenever Litematica, MiniHUD, Tweakeroo, or Item Scroller is installed.

hotkeys.does: Settings for every Masa mod (Litematica, MiniHUD, Tweakeroo, Item Scroller)

mods.name: Mod Menu
mods.what: Adds a 'Mods' button to the pause and title screens so you can open config screens for Do a Barrel Roll, Jade, AppleSkin, and Masa's mods.
features: In-game Mods list accessible from ESC pause screen and title screen
Direct button to open each Fabric mod's configuration GUI
Search and filter installed client and library mods
mods.lunar_note: Add modmenu-21.0.0.jar to Lunar's Mods tab (Fabric API is already bundled by Lunar).

hotkeys.does: On the title and pause screen; no hotkey

mods.name: Carpet
mods.what: Server-side (and singleplayer integrated server) technical Minecraft mod by gnembon for hopper wool counters, /tick rate control, AI trackers, and /player fake AFK bots.
features: Spawns fake players (/player <name> spawn, /player <name> attack interval 10) to AFK farms or load chunks
Hopper Counters (hoppers pointing into colored wool blocks measure exact items/hour farm rates)
Tick control (/tick warp, /tick freeze, /tick step) and MSPT/TPS profiler (/log tps, /log mobcaps) for creative/singleplayer farm testing
Accurate Block Placement protocol server support so Tweakeroo/Litematica Easy Place can orient pistons and observers cleanly
mods.lunar_note: Server-side mod: works in Lunar singleplayer worlds (integrated server) or when installed on the dedicated server; on a vanilla multiplayer server where you are only a client, Carpet commands will not run.

hotkeys.does: Chat command, no hotkeys: /carpet list shows every rule

hotkeys_source: Defaults read from each mod’s 26.3 source on GitHub (sakura-ryoko/litematica, minihud, tweakeroo, itemscroller, malilib; enjarai/do-a-barrel-roll at 1.21.11), 2026-10-24.
hotkeys_notes: “M + C” means hold M, then press C.
Clash: Lunar’s waypoint menu and Litematica’s menu both use M. Rebind one: Litematica under M + C → Hotkeys, or Lunar’s under Esc → Options → Controls.
Lunar: Right Shift opens Lunar’s mod menu, N makes a waypoint, M opens the waypoint list.
